Hi Elena — great to hear the activation is moving forward. Short answers up front: both channels are supported; we prefer the portal for long-term scale, but email is a supported backstop if your AP cannot onboard quickly.

High-level guidance:
- Portal: best for guaranteed idempotency and large volume. It provides immediate ACKs and structured parsing.
- Email: supported only if the subject token is present and a supported attachment layout (PDF or our compact CSV). If you pick email, include PO and Redwood vendor ID in the subject (example below).

Subject token recommendation (email):
PO: 123456 | VENDOR: CLARITY-6789 | Redwood-PO: 123456
Example subject: "PO: 987654 | VENDOR: CLARITY-6789 | Invoice"

Minimal required fields for PO stamping:
- PO number (po_number) — exact match to our PO pool
- Vendor entity (vendor_id or vendor_name) — used to map to the ledger
- Invoice date (invoice_date)
- Invoice total (invoice_total)
- Line items (description, quantity, unit_price, line_total) OR a summarized total with a PO level match

I attached a compact CSV example we ask partners to use for high-throughput months and our vendor onboarding form (link in footer). If you plan to stick with email, we'll enable a subject-token-based parser and send an ACK to the From address on receipt.

Next steps: please confirm whether you want to pilot the portal (recommended) or proceed with email fallback. If email, we need one sample CSV backfilled with two POs so we can validate mapping.

Elena — thanks for the trimmed CSV. I validated it against our compact CSV example and noted two small gaps that will block PO stamping:
1) Your file uses "VendorName" rather than a discrete vendor_id column. If you cannot include Redwood's vendor_id immediately, please populate vendor_name exactly as it appears in the PO (case-sensitive) and add the tax_id column to improve matching.
2) Line item totals are present, but we need either individual unit_price + quantity OR a flag column "aggregate_line=true" to accept single-line aggregates.

About ACKs: for the email path we emit a machine-readable acknowledgment to the sender address. Format: JSON blob with receipt_id, parsed_po_numbers, and status. We'll also send a human-readable receipt. Both will be available in the portal dashboard if you later onboard.

Proposed path for the pilot:
- Week 0: we enable email parser for your sending domain and provide an example subject token to include.
- Week 1: you send 10 pilot invoices (CSV) to billing_ops@redwood.ai. We validate mapping and return ACKs.
- Week 2: if mapping success >95%, we flip to regular cadence; otherwise, migrate to portal pilot.

If you approve, I can set the pilot flag and loop our AP integrator (Vanessa) to schedule a short tech call (30 min) to confirm the CSV column mapping.
